products.title: CalDigit TS4 Thunderbolt 4 18-in-1 Hub
products.description: The CalDigit TS4 is a professional-grade Thunderbolt 4 18-in-1 Hub designed to transform a notebook or PC into a full-fledged workstation. It features a comprehensive array of ports, including three Thunderbolt 4 ports for data speeds up to 40 Gb/s, three USB-C 3.2 Gen 2 ports, and five USB-A 3.2 Gen 2 ports. For multimedia and connectivity, it includes a DisplayPort 1.4 output (supporting up to 8K resolution or dual 4K 60 Hz displays), a 2.5 Gigabit Ethernet port, SD and microSD UHS-II card slots, and a 3.5mm combo audio jack. The hub provides up to 98W of power delivery to the host device and is compatible with macOS and Windows.

products.title: CalDigit Thunderbolt 4 Pro Dock
products.description: The CalDigit Thunderbolt 4 Pro Dock is a high-performance docking station designed to expand a Mac's connectivity through a single Thunderbolt 4 or 3 cable. It provides 18 ports, including three Thunderbolt 4 ports, five USB-A ports, three USB-C ports, and supports dual 6K 60Hz displays or a single 8K display. It also features SD and microSD 4.0 UHS-II card readers, a DisplayPort 1.4, and a 2.5 Gigabit Ethernet port, while delivering up to 98W of power to charge a connected laptop.

products.title: Thunderbolt 4 Dock for Quad Monitors
products.description: Expand your productivity with the Plugable Thunderbolt 4 Dock, designed for seamless connectivity and high-performance multitasking. This docking station supports up to four displays, including 2x HDMI and 2x Thunderbolt, with resolutions up to 4K or a single 8K display. It offers robust 100W (96W certified) host charging, ensuring your laptop stays powered. With three 40Gbps Thunderbolt ports, you benefit from rapid data transfer and 15W charging for connected devices. Additional features include high-speed USB ports, Gigabit Ethernet, an SD card slot, and audio connectivity, consolidating all your peripherals into one hub. Compatible with Windows 10+, macOS 11+, and ChromeOS 100+, this dock is a versatile solution for modern workstations. Plugable provides lifetime support for this product.

products.title: Plugable Thunderbolt 4 Dock with 100W Charging (TBT4-UD5)
products.description: The Plugable TBT4-UD5 is a Thunderbolt 4 certified docking station designed for modern workspaces, compatible with Windows 10 or later and macOS (with specific display support for M1/M2/M3 Pro/Max). This versatile hub features 13 ports, including two HDMI 2.0 ports supporting dual 4K 60Hz displays or a single 8K display via its Thunderbolt 4 downstream port. It provides up to 100W Power Delivery (96W certified) to charge laptops and offers high-speed data transfer via 40Gbps Thunderbolt 4 ports, a 10Gbps USB-C port, and four USB-A ports. Additional connectivity includes Gigabit Ethernet, SD/Micro SD card readers, and a combo audio jack.

products.title: Surface Thunderbolt 4 Dock
products.description: The Surface Thunderbolt 4 Dock is a high-performance connectivity hub designed to transform your Surface computer into a desktop workstation. It features ultra-high-speed data transfer via USB4/Thunderbolt 4, supporting up to two 4K monitors at 60Hz and data speeds up to 40Gbps. The dock provides up to 96W of power passthrough to charge your laptop and accessories efficiently. It is equipped with a versatile array of ports, including front-facing and rear-facing USB-A and USB-C ports, an Ethernet port (2.5 Gbit/s), and a 3.5mm audio jack. Built with inclusivity in mind, it includes raised tactile indicators to help users with low vision identify ports easily. Additionally, the dock and power supply unit enclosures are made from 20% ocean-bound plastic, reflecting a commitment to sustainability.

products.title: Razer Thunderbolt Dock
products.description: The Razer Thunderbolt 4 Dock Chroma is a sleek, 10-port docking station designed for high-performance connectivity. products.title: Surface Thunderbolt 4 Dock for Business
products.description: The Microsoft Surface Thunderbolt 4 Dock for Business is a versatile docking station designed to expand the capabilities of compatible Surface computers. It features a Thunderbolt 4 host connection via an integrated cable and provides three 40 Gb/s USB-C ports supporting external 4K displays and up to 15W power delivery. The dock also includes three USB-A 3.1 Gen 2 ports for high-speed data transfer, a 2.5G Ethernet LAN port for wired networking, and a 3.5mm audio jack. It supports dual 4K displays at 60 Hz and includes a 165W AC adapter providing up to 96W power passthrough. The design incorporates 20% ocean-bound plastic in the enclosures and features tactile port indicators for accessibility.

products.title: Thunderbolt 4 Multimedia Pro Dock
products.description: The Satechi Thunderbolt 4 Multimedia Pro Dock is a 16-in-1 docking station designed for content creators using Windows or Mac setups. It features a Thunderbolt 4 host connection supporting up to 40 Gb/s and 96W power delivery. The dock includes a wide array of connectivity options: one USB-C 3.2 Gen 2 port, three USB-A 3.2 Gen 2 ports, two USB-A 3.2 Gen 1 ports, and one USB-A 2.0 port for charging. For video, it offers two DisplayPort 1.4 and two HDMI 2.1 ports, supporting up to four external displays on Windows. Additionally, it provides SD and microSD card slots, a 2.5 GbE Gigabit Ethernet port, and a 3.5mm headphone/microphone combo jack. Constructed from aircraft-grade aluminum with silicone rubber sides, it can be positioned horizontally or vertically using the included stand.

products.title: Universal Thunderbolt 4 Dock
products.description: This Lenovo ThinkPad Universal Thunderbolt 4 Dock offers a reliable and consistent enterprise-grade docking experience, providing seamless data, video, and power connectivity. With a single Thunderbolt cable, you can connect up to four 4K displays or one 8K display, enjoy lightning-fast 40 Gbps transfer speeds, and benefit from enhanced dynamic power charging up to 100W. It's designed for all Thunderbolt 3, Thunderbolt 4, USB 4, and USB-C Windows-based systems, offering limitless adaptability. The dock also supports remote management through Lenovo Dock Manager, allowing for silent firmware updates without user interruption.
